name: Anim Modifier Test
author: Cassieandstuff
description: Test only, not for release: wraps 0_master's 1HM_Idle clip (the Weap_1HM_Idle_Behavior state 1HM_Idle, the drawn one-handed idle) in a CBAnimModifier. In combat it plays Bow_IdleHeld; otherwise H2H_Idle. Needs [AnimModifier] bEnable=true; with it off, the vanilla idle plays.
